vo.en: You can actually feel two noses.

visual.description: A dramatic close-up of a man looking straight into the camera with an intense expression.

vo.en: Try this right now to glitch your sensory map. Cross your middle finger over your index finger.

vo.en: Now close your eyes and gently rub the tip of your nose right between those crossed fingertips.

vo.en: Wait, it gets even creepier once your nervous system panics. Your brain cannot process these reversed touch signals.

vo.en: Because your fingers are swapped, your sensory cortex glitches and sends two separate spatial signals.

vo.en: Aristotle discovered this ancient body hack thousands of years ago to show how easily touch tricks the mind.
